narration.en: An oxy-acetylene flame is hot enough to cut and weld steel. Acetylene, or ethyne, is the simplest alkyne, and its triple bond gives it unusual chemistry.
narration.kn: ಆಕ್ಸಿ-ಅಸಿಟಿಲೀನ್ ಜ್ವಾಲೆ ಉಕ್ಕನ್ನು ಕತ್ತರಿಸುವಷ್ಟು ಬಿಸಿ. ಅಸಿಟಿಲೀನ್ ಅಥವಾ ಈಥೈನ್ ಅತಿ ಸರಳ ಆಲ್ಕೈನ್; ಅದರ ತ್ರಿಬಂಧ ವಿಶಿಷ್ಟ ರಸಾಯನಶಾಸ್ತ್ರ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: In ethyne each carbon is sp hybridised; the molecule is linear (180°), and the C≡C bond (120 pm) is one σ and two π bonds. Ethyne is made from calcium carbide and water: CaC₂ + 2H₂O → C₂H₂ + Ca(OH)₂. Alkynes are also made from vicinal dihalides by double dehydrohalogenation with alcoholic KOH followed by sodamide.
body.kn: ಈಥೈನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ಕಾರ್ಬನ್ sp, ಅಣು ರೇಖೀಯ; C≡C ಬಂಧ ಒಂದು σ ಮತ್ತು ಎರಡು π. ಕ್ಯಾಲ್ಸಿಯಂ ಕಾರ್ಬೈಡ್ ಮತ್ತು ನೀರಿನಿಂದ ಈಥೈನ್ ತಯಾರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.

points.en: Vicinal dihalide + alc. KOH, then NaNH₂ → alkyne

Ethyne is made from calcium carbide and water: CaC₂ + 2H₂O → C₂H₂ + Ca(OH)₂. Alkynes are also made from vicinal dihalides by double dehydrohalogenation with alcoholic KOH followed by sodamide.
narration.kn: ಈಥೈನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ ಕಾರ್ಬನ್ sp, ಅಣು ರೇಖೀಯ; C≡C ಬಂಧ ಒಂದು σ ಮತ್ತು ಎರಡು π. ಕ್ಯಾಲ್ಸಿಯಂ ಕಾರ್ಬೈಡ್ ಮತ್ತು ನೀರಿನಿಂದ ಈಥೈನ್ ತಯಾರಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.

body.en: A hydrogen on a triple-bonded carbon is weakly acidic, because the sp carbon (50% s-character) holds the electron pair of the anion firmly. So HC≡CH > H₂C=CH₂ > CH₃–CH₃ in acidity, and terminal alkynes react with Na or NaNH₂ to give acetylides. Alkynes add H₂, X₂ and HX in two steps. With water, dilute H₂SO₄ and Hg²⁺ at 333 K, ethyne gives ethanal and propyne gives propanone. Passed through a red-hot iron tube at 873 K, ethyne trimerises to benzene.
body.kn: sp ಕಾರ್ಬನ್‌ನ 50% s-ಲಕ್ಷಣದಿಂದ ಅಂತ್ಯ ಆಲ್ಕೈನ್‌ಗಳ ಹೈಡ್ರೋಜನ್ ದುರ್ಬಲ ಆಮ್ಲೀಯ. ಆಮ್ಲೀಯತೆ: ಈಥೈನ್ > ಈಥೀನ್ > ಈಥೇನ್. Hg²⁺ ಜೊತೆ ಜಲಸಂಯೋಜನೆಯಿಂದ ಈಥೈನ್ ಎಥನಾಲ್ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: What mass of ethyne is obtained from 32 g of calcium carbide with excess water? (Ca = 40, C = 12, H = 1)

steps.en: CaC₂ + 2H₂O → C₂H₂ + Ca(OH)₂: 1 mol CaC₂ gives 1 mol C₂H₂.
Molar mass of CaC₂ = 64 g mol⁻¹, so 32 g = 0.50 mol.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. What mass of ethyne is obtained from 32 g of calcium carbide with excess water? (Ca = 40, C = 12, H = 1)

problem.en: Why does hydration of ethyne give ethanal and not vinyl alcohol?

steps.en: Water adds across one π bond to give CH₂=CH–OH (an enol).
The enol is unstable and rearranges (tautomerises): the O–H hydrogen moves to carbon.
